breakable_arsenal.mechanism: Reinforced glass can be broken to enter directly. Forcing entry triggers UAV and reveals position to all enemies.
breakable_arsenal.backpack_loot: Added 4 Lv. 3 Backpacks to standard arsenal

ultra_airdrop.mechanism: Capture-based late-game drop. Minimap position revealed during capture. Shoot surrounding crystal pillars to speed up capture.

rewards.armor: Ultra Helmet and Vest (stronger than Lv. 4, durability never drops below 25%)

starter_gear_by_time.0_200s: UZI, 6 Med Kits, 2 Inhalers, Lv. 1 Helmet, Lv. 1 Vest, Lv. 2 Backpack
starter_gear_by_time.200_400s: MAC18-I, 6 Med Kits, 2 Inhalers, Lv. 2 Helmet, Lv. 2 Vest, Lv. 2 Backpack
starter_gear_by_time.400s_plus: MAC10-II, 6 Med Kits, 2 Inhalers, Lv. 2 Helmet, Lv. 2 Vest, Lv. 2 Backpack

one_time_team_revive.condition: Must land near teammates. Triggers automatic 60s revive countdown for all eliminated teammates if at least one player is alive.

duo_squad_mode.revival_point_and_card_gear: M1917, 6 Med Kits, 2 Inhalers, Lv. 1 Backpack
duo_squad_mode.advanced_revival_point_and_super_card_ge: 6 Med Kits, 2 Inhalers, Lv. 2 Backpack, MAC18-I
duo_squad_mode.spectator_revive_assist: Tap revive assist bubble while spectating to give teammate a discount on Revive Card purchases and bonus buffs upon buying.

cyber_airdrop.mechanism: 2-stage shared capture progress. Stage 1 grants items/buffs to players inside zone. Stage 2 grants permanent round-long damage reduction buff to the unlocker.

clash_squad_mechanics.usability_fixes: If USP is dropped at round start, it will not auto-issue in subsequent rounds.

map_and_general_adjustments.kalahari: Adjusted window vaulting smoothness; fixed zero-damage bug locations.
map_and_general_adjustments.solara: Improved slide interactions and increased slide speed in Hub area.

general.spawn_armor_backpack: Start match with Lv. 2 Backpack; Lv. 1 Vest drop rate reduced, Lv. 2 Vest drop rate increased; added 12 Lv. 3 Helmets and 12 Lv. 3 Vests across map.
general.vehicle_speed_boost: Added brief speed boost burst button; vehicles explode instantly at 0 HP; reduced post-explosion burn effect.
general.rating_medals: In-game actions award Silver/Gold medals for bonus rank points and potential rank jumps.
general.movement: Falling from height no longer interrupts sprint.
